inputs: a project root or folder holding supporting artifacts: results-audit.json, data tables and figures, claim-map.json and experiment-plan.md, literature evidence tables and novelty packs, claim-evidence-bindings.json and paper-plan.md, issue-board.md, manuscript source, author notes
optional register, venue, source format, and page or word budget
optional validator results from the owning research skills
outputs: writing-intake.md and writing-intake.json listing what the draft can lean on and the gaps
claim-ledger.md and claim-ledger.json with ready, careful, blocked, excluded, and proposed claims
outline.md: one line per paragraph with its claims and exhibits, edited and approved by the author before any prose
a short writing brief with job, reader, register, sources, and gates
first-draft prose, section by section in the source format, with [EVIDENCE NEEDED] and [CITATION NEEDED] markers and ledger source comments
check_draft_numbers.py, outline check, and prose_tells.py summary lines for the handoff
